notes: Cycle: CUET (UG) 2026 = academic year 2026-27. The primary source is the NTA's official university-wise 'CUET (UG) 2026 programme mapping' PDFs (cdnbbsr.s3waas.gov.in), linked from https://cuet.nta.nic.in/participating-universities/ (central, state and other-government lists). All 97 public-institution mapping PDFs (central, state, other government) were read as text and searched for B.Tech/BE/integrated B.Tech-M.Tech. Being in the mapping means the programme accepts CUET scores, not necessarily that CUET is the only route. See admission_note for CUK (50/50 with JEE), CURAJ and CUJ (JoSAA/CSAB first, CUET for leftover seats), Tezpur (CUET only for 30% of Food Engg seats) and NIFTEM (JEE/NEET/CUET). Seat counts are mostly null: the mapping PDFs do not publish intake, and only Tezpur FET is confirmed from an official prospectus. Universities from the brief with NO B.Tech/BE/integrated B.Tech in their CUET 2026 mapping: University of Hyderabad, Central University of Haryana, University of Allahabad, Central University of Kashmir, Central University of Jammu, Sikkim University, Mizoram University, Rajiv Gandhi University, Visva-Bharati, Jamia Millia Islamia, BHU, AMU, Central University of Kerala, JNU. Their absence from the mapping is official evidence that they do not admit B.Tech via CUET. Only DU-FoT and Tezpur (official) and JMI and CUH (aggregator) were checked for a JEE route. The others may run JEE-based B.Tech or have none; this was not verified. Private and deemed universities (120 + 27 on the NTA lists) were not scanned. Not done: the NTA Information Bulletin itself was not parsed (the per-university mappings supersede it). The Pondicherry rank-list PDFs returned HTTP 503, so the Pondicherry seat figures are search-snippet only.
